# What the data-dict export loses: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)

The YAML files here follow data-dict spec 0.1.0. They describe the common data format, so they validate against its parquet files. The records in `metadata/` remain canonical. This table counts what the export drops or flattens into text.

| | `2015-2016` | `2017-2020` | `2021-2023` |
|---|---|---|---|
| variables exported | 86 | 64 | 63 |
| variables whose numeric code labels went to `details` (no labeled numeric codes) | 62 | 44 | 44 |
| missing or unresolved codes, typed only in the `__code` column's labels | 130 | 88 | 89 |
| variables listed by name only (no type the records can support) | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| availability entries (wave by form, with n), summarized as one line of text | 85 | 63 | 62 |
| field origins (publisher, data file, rule, hand, model) not exported | 344 | 256 | 252 |
| derived properties (scale signatures), not exported | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| release id not expressible as data-dict `version` (needs semver or a date) | 1 | 1 | 1 |
